contacts.institution_name: Karol Szymanowski Academy of Music in Katowice

country.evidence_quote: Founded in 1929, the Academy is the oldest state higher education institution located in Upper Silesia, Poland. It offers artistic studies in the field of music and holds a variety of artistic events such as concerts, masterclasses, workshops, competitions and conferences.

contacts.notes: site found via: website column in the sheet. mode: gemini (read by the paid reader gemini-3.1-flash-lite (paid key): free Gemini was unavailable).

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: The Academy’s campus is famous for its concert hall, built in 2007 and the spatious patio that fuses an old, neo-Gothic redbrick buildings to modern architecture, located at Zacisze 3, Katowice. A virtual tour is available here.
Classes are also given in the Instrumental and Vocal Faculties’ building (Szafranka 5, Katowice), and at the Jazz and Popular Music Faculty (Krasińskiego 27, Katowice).
